text:
Alex: Hey infra — I tried opening the staging model-health dashboard and got a 403. Can someone share a shortlink or grant view? @Maddy @Jordan
Maddy: Which one exactly? model-health or region-health? staging or prod?
Alex: model-health for the staging cluster (service tag: model-serving-staging). URL I tried: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd1234/model-health-staging — returns 403 in the browser.
Jordan: That's likely the org RBAC. Staging dashboards are gated to the `staging-grafana-viewers` group. We do have a shortlink but it still checks group membership.
Alex: Can you paste the shortlink? I need it for an async eval. If permissions are the blocker I can open a permissions ticket.
Jordan: Shortlink (internal): https://grafana.internal/r/sm-staging-health
Jordan: If you want view access permanently, please open an infra-perms ticket here: https://tickets.internal/infra/permissions and request `grafana:view` for group `staging-grafana-viewers`. If you need a quick temporary unblock, @Ops Admin can add a one-off grant.
Ops Admin: I can add a temporary grant. What is your username? (I'll add until EOD)
Alex: alex@redwood.ai — thanks
Ops Admin: Done. You should be able to access now. I logged the grant: permission-grant/1729991240 by Ops Admin (expires in 8h).
Alex: Confirmed, I can open the dashboard now :tada: — thanks!
Alex: Quick follow-up: alerts are noisy for model-serving-staging. We've been seeing the p95 latency alert fire multiple times overnight. Current alert threshold is 400ms.
Maddy: Huh — I thought we set it to 500ms a few weeks ago. Which rule is firing? alert id or panel?
Alex: Alert rule: model-serving-staging-p95-latency (ID: alert-8743). Query snippet:
```
max_over_time(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) [5m:])
```
Alex: It's spiking to ~520ms occasionally, but a lot of short-lived blips trigger it.
Jordan: Two options: raise to 600ms or add a for: 5m to reduce flapping. Which do you prefer?
Alex: Leaning towards increasing threshold to 600ms for staging. We use tighter for prod.
Sam: I'm fine with 600ms for staging. Approve the change.
Jordan: Cool. I'll update the alert to threshold=600ms and add `for: 5m` to reduce noise. I'll patch the rule now and annotate the change.
Jordan: Patch applied: model-serving-staging-p95-latency -> threshold 600ms, for 5m. Change-id: infra-alert-change/1729991500
deploy-bot: permission-grant-record created (grant_id=pg-1729991240) and alert-change recorded (change_id=infra-alert-change/1729991500)
Alex: Thanks. One more thing — if someone else hits 403 in the future, quick workaround is to use our internal shortlink proxy (no RBAC) for read-only links while perms ticket is pending:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  https://internal-api.redwood/v1/grafana/shortlink/abcd1234
```
Jordan: Note: proxy respects audit, but only for short-lived tokens. Don't use for prod sensitive dashboards.
Alex: Closing this thread. If alerts keep flapping I'll open an eval runbook card. :white_check_mark:
